summary: Organizations can deliver trusted digital experiences to users with WSO2 Identity Server, a powerful identity and access management solution for on-premises or cloud environments. It secures apps for external consumers, internal workforces, business customers, and API access. The solution supports various authentication methods and provides fine-grained API access policies. WSO2 Identity Server is used by businesses to simplify secure access for customers and partners. Its features include advanced RBAC, customizable branding, and support for various organization hierarchies. The solution also provides best API security using the FAPI standard. This enables organizations to ensure the right apps are available to customers and maintain high user engagement.
